title: Spherical Harmonic Sliced Wasserstein Displacement Interpolation for Acoustic Source and Reflection Density Modeling
summary: Spatial room impulse responses (SRIRs) capture directional distributions of acoustic sound-sources and their reflections. However, collecting SRIRs of moving sound-sources remains a challenge, requiring complex interpolations across measurements that account for multi-path spatial-temporal dynamics. This paper investigates the Wasserstein metric and displacement for evaluating interpolated SRIR echo densities in the spherical harmonic domain.
